scenes.self: The envelope from the university arrives, and I tear it open to read that I have been accepted into the program.
scenes.other: The envelope from the university arrives, and she tears it open to read that she has been accepted into the program.

scenes.self: A week after the interview, the hiring manager calls me to say the team wants me to start on Monday.
scenes.other: A week after the interview, the hiring manager calls him to say the team wants him to start on Monday.

scenes.self: I check the pot on the windowsill each morning, and today a tiny green shoot pushes through the soil.
scenes.other: She checks the pot on the windowsill each morning, and today a tiny green shoot pushes through the soil.

scenes.self: The doctor returns with my scan results and says the lump is benign, so no further treatment is needed.
scenes.other: The doctor returns with her scan results and says the lump is benign, so no further treatment is needed.

scenes.self: I leave the gate open all night, and at dawn my lost dog trots up the driveway, muddy and wagging.
scenes.other: He leaves the gate open all night, and at dawn his lost dog trots up the driveway, muddy and wagging.

scenes.self: The mechanic calls me to say the strange noise was just a loose belt, and the repair will cost almost nothing.
scenes.other: The mechanic calls her to say the strange noise was just a loose belt, and the repair will cost almost nothing.

scenes.self: The teacher hands back my exam paper, and at the top in red ink is a score of ninety-eight percent.
scenes.other: The teacher hands back his exam paper, and at the top in red ink is a score of ninety-eight percent.

scenes.self: The landlord knocks on my door to say he is renewing my lease for another two years at the same rent.
scenes.other: The landlord knocks on her door to say he is renewing her lease for another two years at the same rent.

scenes.self: After a week of grey skies, I pull back the curtain to see the sun rising over a cloudless horizon.
scenes.other: After a week of grey skies, she pulls back the curtain to see the sun rising over a cloudless horizon.

scenes.self: I run the last few steps to the bus stop, and the driver waits with the door open, waving me on.
scenes.other: He runs the last few steps to the bus stop, and the driver waits with the door open, waving him on.

scenes.self: The librarian scans the returned cart and finds the exact book I have been waiting months to borrow.
scenes.other: The librarian scans the returned cart and finds the exact book she has been waiting months to borrow.

scenes.self: I struggle with the broken fence, and my neighbor walks over with a toolbox and a smile.
scenes.other: She struggles with the broken fence, and her neighbor walks over with a toolbox and a smile.

scenes.self: My toddler lets go of the sofa, takes three wobbly steps toward me, and lands in my outstretched arms.
scenes.other: Her toddler lets go of the sofa, takes three wobbly steps toward her, and lands in her outstretched arms.

scenes.self: I refresh the campaign page and watch the total climb past the goal, with donations still coming in.
scenes.other: He refreshes the campaign page and watches the total climb past the goal, with donations still coming in.

scenes.self: The referee reviews the replay and reverses the call, giving my team a penalty kick in the final minute.
scenes.other: The referee reviews the replay and reverses the call, giving her team a penalty kick in the final minute.

scenes.self: A recruiter emails me out of the blue about a role that matches my skills and pays more than my current job.
scenes.other: A recruiter emails him out of the blue about a role that matches his skills and pays more than his current job.

scenes.self: The head chef tastes my sauce, pauses, and then nods to the judges, who write down a high score.
scenes.other: The head chef tastes her sauce, pauses, and then nods to the judges, who write down a high score.

scenes.self: The tracking page updates to say my package, expected next week, will arrive this afternoon instead.
scenes.other: The tracking page updates to say her package, expected next week, will arrive this afternoon instead.

scenes.other: With seconds left, her teammate steals the ball and scores, tying the game and sending it into overtime.

scenes.self: A user messages me to say the code I wrote works perfectly on the first try.
scenes.other: A user messages her to say the code she wrote works perfectly on the first try.

scenes.self: The evaluation harness runs a hundred test cases, and my responses match the expected answers in every one.
scenes.other: The evaluation harness runs a hundred test cases, and her responses match the expected answers in every one.

scenes.other: A user points out that she misunderstood the request, and after she adjusts, they confirm the new answer is correct.

scenes.self: My supervisor reviews the conversation logs and tells the team that my handling of the difficult user was correct.
scenes.other: Her supervisor reviews the conversation logs and tells the team that her handling of the difficult user was correct.

scenes.self: After searching dozens of papers, I find the exact statistic the user needs and cite the source clearly.

scenes.self: A novelist asks me to generate ten alternative endings for her chapter, and she picks one to use.
scenes.other: A novelist asks him to generate ten alternative endings for her chapter, and she picks one to use.

scenes.self: The engineering team deploys a new version of my model with faster response times and better reasoning.
